title: A repetition schedule you can read
description: You can see why a card has come up now and how to correct a rating made by accident.

blocks.text: An accidental “mastered” mark can take a word you need out of the review. This is a concrete case where a transparent status and an undo let a person put the material back into study.

quote.text: I accidentally clicked mastered on a word I hadn’t known, and now I can’t change it and hence it wont appear in the list of words I need to study.

blocks.text: Undo a rating and see what follows

Show the last rating and the next scheduled appearance. After an undo, explain how the queue will change. For reviewing one topic on its own, offer a standalone session and keep it distinct from the normal schedule.
What such an edit does not prove

A queue you can read helps you manage it, but it does not guarantee retention. A complaint about repeating something many times to no effect has to be investigated separately: what the questions contain, how they are answered, and what is recalled afterwards.
